title: About SMARTAI News
body:
**SMARTAI News** (`smartaiintel.com`, also referred to as SmartAI Intel News or SAI News) is an independently operated digital news publication providing verified reporting, timely updates and analytical context across United States national affairs, world diplomacy, global security, technology and artificial intelligence, business and financial markets, and international football and sports.

### Editorial desks and coverage
Our newsroom organises reporting across six dedicated subject desks:

- **US News:** Congressional legislation, executive branch policy, federal courts and domestic governance.
- **World & Global Affairs:** Multilateral diplomacy, international summits, trade relations, elections and climate policy.
- **War & Security:** Defence policy, military logistics, cyber operations, sanctions enforcement and transnational security.
- **Technology & AI:** Semiconductor supply chains, frontier artificial intelligence, enterprise computing, cloud infrastructure and digital regulation.
- **Business & Economy:** Corporate earnings, capital markets, energy infrastructure, labour policy and macroeconomic indicators.
- **Football & Sports:** International football, club competitions, tournament qualification, basketball, motorsport and global athletics.

### Editorial workflow
SMARTAI News is operated by its publisher with contributing desk writers covering their respective beats. Every article is reviewed against primary documents, official statements or established reporting before publication, in accordance with our [Editorial & Corrections Policy](/editorial-policy/).

### Contact our newsroom
For editorial enquiries, press releases, corrections or general questions, email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com** or visit our [Contact page](/contact/).

title: Contact
body:
We welcome reader feedback, news tips, press enquiries and correction requests.

### Editorial & general enquiries
Email our newsroom directly at **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com**.

### Requesting a correction
If you believe a published SMARTAI News article contains a factual inaccuracy, please email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com** with:

1. The headline or direct URL of the article.
2. The specific passage or figure in question.
3. Supporting documentation, official records or a verifiable primary source.

Verified factual errors are corrected promptly in line with our [Editorial & Corrections Policy](/editorial-policy/).

### Advertising & privacy requests
For advertising enquiries or data-privacy requests under our [Privacy Policy](/privacy/), contact **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com**. Please do not send passwords, payment card numbers or sensitive personal identification documents by email. Messages are handled through Gmail and are subject to Google's applicable terms and privacy practices.

title: Editorial & Corrections Policy
body:
### Editorial responsibility
SMARTAI News (`smartaiintel.com`) is independently operated. Contributing writers prepare articles in their subject areas. The owner and relevant subject-area reviewers check material before publication. Publication responsibility remains with SMARTAI News, including when AI tools assist with an article.

### Sources and verification
We check factual claims against reliable sources and prefer original documents, official records and direct statements where available. We attribute information and quotations, link to supporting material where practical, and distinguish established facts from allegations, estimates and uncertainty. We do not invent quotations, sources or credentials.

### Reporting, analysis and opinion
Opinion and analysis should be clearly labelled. Headlines must fairly represent the article. Unconfirmed claims must not be presented as established facts.

### AI assistance
Our writers primarily write and review articles manually. AI tools are sometimes used to help draft or edit material. Human editors must check facts, quotations, references and context before publication; AI output is not itself a source. Where AI has a substantial role in producing an article or an illustrative image, we will provide an appropriate disclosure. We will not present AI-generated imagery as a photograph of a real event.

### Corrections and updates
We review credible reports of errors and correct verified inaccuracies. Material factual corrections will carry a clear note explaining what changed. Routine spelling or formatting fixes may be made without a separate note. Updates that add new information will be distinguished from corrections when the distinction matters.

To request a correction, email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com** with the article link, the disputed passage and relevant evidence. We do not guarantee a particular response time.

### Attribution and rights
Articles carry the responsible writer's byline. We use text, photographs and other materials only where we have permission, an appropriate licence, or another lawful basis. Required credits and licence notices must be retained.

### Independence and conflicts
Contributors must disclose relevant conflicts to the editor. Sponsored or paid editorial material, if accepted, must be clearly labelled and must not be presented as independent reporting. Advertising must be visually distinguishable from editorial content.

title: Privacy Policy
body:
Last revised: November 12, 2026.

## Who operates this website
SMARTAI News (`https://smartaiintel.com`, also known as SmartAIIntel) is an independently operated digital news publication run by its owner with contributing writers. For privacy questions or data requests, contact **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com**.

## Information processed when you visit
SMARTAI News is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Hosting and security services process standard technical information such as IP addresses, requested URLs, browser and device headers, timestamps and security events to deliver content reliably and protect the website against abuse. Cloudflare processes technical data under its applicable terms and privacy practices; see [Cloudflare's Privacy Policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

## Advertising, Google AdSense and cookies
SMARTAI News uses **Google AdSense** to display advertisements that support our independent journalism. Please note how advertising cookies and related identifiers work on this website:

- **Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies** (such as Google advertising and DoubleClick cookies) and web beacons to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to SMARTAI News or other websites on the internet.
- **Google's use of advertising cookies** enables Google and its partners to serve advertisements to visitors based on their visit to SMARTAI News and/or other sites across the internet.
- **How to opt out of personalized advertising:** Visitors may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting [Google Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com/) (or [My Ad Center](https://myadcenter.google.com/)). Alternatively, you can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting [www.aboutads.info/choices/](https://www.aboutads.info/choices/) or the [Network Advertising Initiative opt-out page](https://optout.networkadvertising.org/).
- To learn more about how Google collects and processes data in connection with advertising and publisher partner sites, please review [How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites) and [Google's Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

If you have not opted out of third-party ad serving, cookies of other third-party vendors or ad networks certified by Google may also be used to serve ads on this website, subject to your applicable regional consent settings.

## European Economic Area (EEA), UK and Swiss visitors
Where required under European Union, United Kingdom or Swiss data-protection laws, visitors are presented with a Google-certified Consent Management Platform (CMP) message aligned with the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF). You can grant, refuse or withdraw consent for personalized advertising and cookie storage through that consent prompt or via your browser settings at any time.

## Website analytics
We use Cloudflare Web Analytics and Real User Measurements to understand aggregate traffic and page-load performance. You can also manage or clear cookies and local storage directly through your web browser settings.

## Optional browser push notifications
SMARTAI News offers optional breaking-news web push notifications. Browser push alerts are strictly opt-in: no push subscription token is created unless you explicitly click **Allow** in both the on-page banner and your browser's native permission prompt. You can revoke push notification permission at any time in your browser's site settings, which immediately stops further alerts.

## When you contact us
If you email us at **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com**, we receive your email address, message content and any attachments you choose to send. We use this information solely to reply, investigate correction requests or handle editorial and privacy enquiries. Email correspondence is processed through Gmail, provided by Google.

## How information is used and shared
We use technical, analytics and advertising data to deliver and secure the website, fund our journalism through advertising, measure site performance, respond to reader enquiries and comply with applicable legal obligations. We do not sell personal contact details submitted through editorial or reader enquiries.

## Retention
We retain email correspondence only as long as reasonably necessary to resolve enquiries, document editorial corrections or satisfy legal obligations. Technical and advertising logs held by third-party service providers (such as Cloudflare and Google) are governed by their respective retention policies.

## International processing
Our infrastructure, analytics and advertising partners may process data on servers located outside your country of residence in accordance with their published data-protection safeguards.

## Your choices and data-protection rights
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to request access to, correction of, deletion of, or restriction of personal data we hold about you, or to object to certain processing. Email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com** to submit a request. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.

## External links
SMARTAI News articles include source links to external government, institutional and news websites. Visiting an external link is governed by that destination site's own terms and privacy policy.

## Policy updates
We update this Privacy Policy whenever our site features, analytics or advertising practices change and display the latest revision date at the top of this page.
